note: Seconds into the audio. Re-timed 2026-10-11 from watching a recording of the real show (docs/shows/happily-ever-after/README.md): its times are converted to this audio by measured alignment, and the big boundaries are snapped to hits and silences in the audio itself.

recording.note: The recording's time = audio time x scale + offset, measured by docs/shows/happily-ever-after/align_audio.py (2026-10-11). Used by tools/show_sync_checker.html.

scenes.title: Theme fanfare
scenes.look: Grey castle, blue spires, the gate lit yellow; two banks of white and ice-blue searchlights stand and sway, cross over the spire (video 0:17), fan out wide (0:22) and fade before the narrator (0:27); no fireworks

scenes.title: Narrator opening
scenes.look: Searchlights off, the sky dark, the gate a dim steady yellow as the narrator speaks

scenes.title: Magic from the keyhole
scenes.look: As the show is ready to begin (video 0:56), the keyhole blazes yellow and its magic climbs the walls, tinting them gold while the roofs stay blue, then fades back as the singing starts (about 0:59)

scenes.title: Happily Ever After theme song
scenes.look: Gold sparkles fall through the sky, the gate glowing steadily yellow; still no fireworks

scenes.title: Theme song builds
scenes.look: On "...unfold" (video 1:13) a burst of gold magic out of the gate over the lower castle; then red walls under royal-blue roofs, white and ice-blue searchlights; still no fireworks

scenes.title: Theme chorus
scenes.look: The show's first fireworks on the chorus: the castle red under blue roofs, its design traced in running gold magic; white comet fans off the rooftops, big gold and white chrysanthemums, a gold willow, red fans and a red peony

scenes.title: Theme chorus (gold canopy)
scenes.look: On the chorus drop the castle fades slowly to blue from the spire down to its base; a huge gold willow canopy over the spire, white comet fans firing off both sides, a gold brocade crown fading to smoke

scenes.title: Wishing star lands on the castle
scenes.look: Music-box transition: the castle turns royal blue, the sky dark, one bright star

scenes.title: Down in New Orleans (prologue)
scenes.look: Midnight blue, Evangeline the evening star twinkling, small single comets

scenes.title: When You Wish Upon a Star (fanfare)
scenes.look: The castle bright blue as the fanfare plays: a fan of white comets off the rooftops (video 3:05), blue searchlights, white and ice-blue bursts, a green willow at the end

scenes.title: Part of Your World
scenes.look: Blue castle: a red peony over the spire (video 3:23), then big gold chrysanthemums, a white one, and gold and white comet fans off both sides (3:39-3:42)

scenes.title: Out There
scenes.look: Notre Dame by night: the castle icy blue, the bells ringing, the sky mostly dark under purple searchlights; a red peony on "Out there" (video 4:07) and a big white chrysanthemum on the last note (4:25)

scenes.title: When You Wish Upon a Star (interlude)
scenes.look: A wall of pink and violet fountains across the whole castle (video 4:27-4:33), then gold chrysanthemums climbing over the spire

scenes.title: Touch the Sky
scenes.look: Merida's Highlands: emerald and teal castle, Celtic knotwork; her arrow flies at 277 (video 4:47); gold willow, emerald and white strobes, red and gold comets; a gold canopy as Merida speaks (4:38), a white chrysanthemum (4:54), white comet fans (5:06)

scenes.title: Touch the Sky / Up
scenes.look: Up's balloons fill the blue castle and lift the house; a gold burst over the spire (video 5:20), red, white and green comets rising (5:23), big gold chrysanthemums (5:26-5:30)

scenes.title: How Far I'll Go
scenes.look: The heart of Te Fiti on the castle, ocean blues, the manta ray; a dark sky with one white peony (video 5:53), then gold chrysanthemums as the song lifts (6:04) and a white one (6:10)

scenes.title: How Far I'll Go (climax)
scenes.look: The chorus: turquoise searchlights, gold glitter, then big white and gold chrysanthemums over the spire (video 6:34-6:43)

scenes.title: Aladdin: a best friend by your side
scenes.look: Spoken line over gold and purple lamp smoke on a midnight-blue castle

scenes.title: Friend Like Me (instrumental)
scenes.look: Brass patterns and lanterns on the castle, white shells; on three beats the side rooftops fire fans of comets, white, red, then green (video 7:15-7:17)

scenes.title: Trashin' the Camp
scenes.look: Vivid green and chartreuse, green flares and green and orange comets on the drums, green searchlights

scenes.title: Hakuna Matata
scenes.look: A teal-green flash on the change (video 7:37), then the castle magenta-pink under a nearly empty sky

scenes.title: You've Got a Friend in Me
scenes.look: Toy Story from video 7:50: Woody and Buzz on Andy's cloud wallpaper, the castle in primary-coloured blocks; red and yellow bursts

scenes.title: Friendship mash-up
scenes.look: In order (video times): Bare Necessities, the castle green with the Jungle Book characters dancing (8:04); Ralph on a pink castle (8:12); Baymax in his super suit with Hiro, blue towers (8:16); Nick and Judy in the gate, chased off by a rolling doughnut; Inside Out's memory orbs filling the castle, Joy and Sadness (8:30); Mike and Sulley among scream canisters (8:36); multicolour searchlights, steady pastel bursts

scenes.title: That's What Friends Are For
scenes.look: The castle itself sings it, its stonework coming alive; two red and gold peonies on the opening hit; soft gold shells; small gold bursts on the bass line (video 8:45, 8:49), a dark sky otherwise

scenes.title: Friend Like Me (Genie)
scenes.look: Genie in neon, the castle a pulsing marquee; crossing magenta, green and gold comets, gold chrysanthemums; red and green comet fans from the roofs (video 9:17), then a green curtain hanging over the castle on the last big note (9:21); purple castle, big gold and white chrysanthemums (video 9:03-9:08), ice-blue comet fans (9:13)

scenes.title: Friend Like Me (finale)
scenes.look: Genie's big finish: dense magenta, red and green comets fanning out from both sides of the castle, one fan a beat, to his "Ha!"

scenes.title: Olaf: some people are worth melting for
scenes.look: Spoken line; icy blue and purple castle, snowflakes floating up; the sky dark for about 7 s, then one gold willow left of the spire (video 9:43)

scenes.title: Love Is an Open Door
scenes.look: Olaf stays in the centre window to about 582 (video 9:52), then no characters; pink and violet only on the castle, the bursts in the sky gold (some green-gold); gold comet fans from the sides from about 585; no heart shells; gold comets (video 9:48), a gold chrysanthemum (10:00), gold fans (10:06-10:12)

scenes.title: Can You Feel the Love Tonight
scenes.look: Starry indigo; WALL-E and EVE among the constellations, then Simba and Nala as the castle warms to amber with black acacia trees on its lower walls (video 10:25); gold willows building to a gold canopy (green-gold at 10:23, the canopy at 10:29)

scenes.title: You'll Be in My Heart
scenes.look: Magenta, lavender and gold; families on the centre tower's right side: Kala and baby Tarzan, Riley and her family, Dory; pink, violet and white with comets from the terraces; a nearly dark sky, no heart shells

scenes.title: Princess garden
scenes.look: No princesses in the real show: the families' pink and red castle carries on, pink comets from the sides, gold palms and willows, a red peony; it turns royal blue at about 646 (video 11:06); no heart shells; pink comets from the sides and a red peony (10:51), a white chrysanthemum (10:57), gold (11:03-11:09)

scenes.title: I See the Light
scenes.look: Lanterns rise; a big white burst at 11:29, then a wall of red and pink peonies at 11:38-11:42

scenes.title: I See the Light (lanterns)
scenes.look: A quiet sky full of lanterns, sparse gold willows; a white chrysanthemum as it ends (video 12:03)

scenes.title: The Emperor's warning
scenes.look: "The flower that blooms in adversity...": the Emperor's praise of Mulan, both in the gate; dark navy and crimson; two lone shells, a pink and green ring then a big gold willow; no gong; two lone shells: a white chrysanthemum (video 12:21) and a gold willow (12:26)

scenes.title: Villains attack
scenes.look: Electric lime, toxic purple and blood red; crossing green searchlights, crackling green comets, red bursts; a red rocket, then red peonies (12:40, 12:45)

scenes.title: To Die For
scenes.look: The Incredibles fight a giant robot from about 12:44 (video); lightning; the castle blue and purple; big red peonies (12:55), then white chrysanthemums (13:00-13:04)

scenes.title: He's a Pirate
scenes.look: Scar and Simba fight (777, video 13:07), then Aladdin and Jafar as the snake (799, video 13:30); the castle cracks and burns; flame jets on the terraces; red, orange and gold; red comet fans off the rooftops (13:14), red peonies (13:19, 13:29)

scenes.title: He's a Pirate (green barrage)
scenes.look: Maleficent after the snake: her green dragon fire along the ground; emerald shells and lime comets; green comet fans firing off both sides

scenes.title: He's a Pirate (red and gold)
scenes.look: Dense red chrysanthemums and gold willow fans; red fans and a white chrysanthemum (13:46), white and red (13:53)

scenes.title: He's a Pirate (finale)
scenes.look: A white V fan of comets off the battlements at 14:08, then the sky turns red: red comets and fountains firing across the base, red peonies, flame jets

scenes.title: Embers
scenes.look: "Remember who you are": the castle near-black with an ember core, Mufasa in the clouds; between his lines two gold comets (video 14:38 and 14:46)

scenes.title: Go the Distance (the castle rebuilds)
scenes.look: Cyan, royal blue and gold columns; Hercules in gold light; the keyhole glows; sky nearly dark

scenes.title: Go the Distance
scenes.look: The rebuilt castle blue, big gold chrysanthemums over the spire (video 15:29-15:46) as the pyro resumes

scenes.title: Go the Distance (hero mosaic)
scenes.look: On "I can go the distance" (video 15:59) the castle turns to the stained-glass hero mosaic; gold chrysanthemums, red comets and a white chrysanthemum (16:06)

scenes.title: Go the Distance (gold canopy)
scenes.look: No smiley shells: white comet fans off the rooftops (video 16:28), red and gold bursts (16:32-16:36), a huge gold canopy (16:40)

scenes.title: Narrator closing
scenes.look: "Find your Happily Ever After": the stained-glass heroes stay lit through the narration, the keyhole glows; no searchlights, no fireworks

scenes.title: Happily Ever After (reprise)
scenes.look: The stained-glass hero mosaic stays on the castle as the reprise begins; white comets arc up and cross over the spire (video 17:15-17:27), no searchlights

scenes.title: You Can Fly
scenes.look: Tink takes off from the spire; red, gold, green and cyan; gold palms, red strobes, lime and purple; then a dense glitter barrage fills the sky, orange, then green, pink and orange again; gold comet fans off the rooftops as Tink takes off (17:34), no shaped shells

scenes.title: You Can Fly (gold arcs)
scenes.look: Gold comets arching over the spire; white comet fans off the rooftops (video 18:15)

scenes.title: Final chorus, keyhole opens
scenes.look: Castle gold and red; a rainbow barrage, then a white and gold mine fan from the castle's foot

scenes.title: The last hit
scenes.look: "After!": the white flash, then gold willows hanging over a castle washed in gold

after_show.note: Separate track after the show; not part of it.
